12 dict begin
begincmap
/CIDSystemInfo 3 dict dup begin
    /Registry (Adobe) def
    /Ordering (Identity) def
    /Supplement 0 def
end def
/CMapName /Custom def
/CMapVersion 1 def
/CMapType 0 def
/WMode 0 def
1 begincodespacerange
<0000> <FFFF>
endcodespacerange

endcmap
CMapName currentdict /CMap defineresource pop
end
